title: Peanut Chutney Roti Roll
subtitle: Whole wheat roti rolled around a coarse, spiced peanut chutney.
protein: ~18–22g protein per adult (2 rolls) — peanuts + wheat

nightPrep.label: Night Before
items: Make a batch of dry peanut chutney (shengdana chutney pudi) — keeps for weeks
Mix chutney with yogurt or ghee to make a spreadable paste; refrigerate
Optionally make roti dough — keeps overnight in the fridge

method.title: Make dry chutney (~10 min)
items: Pulse roasted peanuts {1 cup} in a dry blender — 5–6 short pulses until coarse crumble; do not over-blend into paste
Add dry red chili {2}, cumin seeds {½ tsp}, hing {¼ tsp}, salt {½ tsp}, aamchur {1 tsp}
Pulse 2–3 more times to combine — keep it coarse and sandy, not smooth
Stores in an airtight jar for 2–3 weeks at room temperature

method.title: Morning assembly
items: Heat roti on tawa — 30 sec per side; smear ghee {½ tsp} while warm
Spread dry chutney {2 tbsp} over roti — if too dry, mix a spoonful of yogurt into the chutney first
Roll tightly and serve immediately or wrap in foil

method.label: Toddler version
items: Use chutney made without dry red chili — pulse peanuts with just cumin, hing, salt, aamchur
Mix {1 tsp} chutney with yogurt {1 tbsp} to make a mild creamy spread
Soft roti cut into strips or small pieces — easier for her to manage than a roll
Add soft paneer pieces or thinly sliced cucumber inside

method.label: Tip
method.text: The chutney is the protein workhorse here — 2 tbsp of dry peanut chutney has ~7–8g protein. Double-layer it for more flavor and protein.
